# gate

Pre-commit gate: oxlint, oxfmt, tsc, vitest and the Fallow score, one compact verdict per check.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--checks` | str | no | `lint,format,tsc,tests,fallow` | Comma list of checks to run |
| `--tests` | str | no | `""` | Test paths passed to vitest; empty runs the whole suite |
| `--score` | int | no | `100` | Lowest Fallow score that passes |
| `--lint` | str | no | `bun run lint:check` | Lint command |
| `--format` | str | no | `bun run format:check` | Format check command |
| `--tsc` | str | no | `bunx tsc --noEmit` | Type-check command, run through the tsc-errors block |
| `--vitest` | str | no | `bunx vitest run` | Test command, run through the test-summary block |
| `--fallow` | str | no | `bunx fallow` | Fallow command, run through the fallow-health block |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run gate
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys ok, failed, results.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/gate.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
